# Make Rich Text From Markdown

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Makes rich text from Markdown.

## Syntax

~~~~text
richTextFromMarkdown(markdown: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
richTextFromMarkdown(markdown: Rich Text)
~~~~
